dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white horizontal band visible across the greater coverts; thick and clearly defined against dark gray/blackish wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, prominent white margins along the outer webs of folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Rectangular/elliptical high-contrast white patch on the posterior neck, bordered by black above and greenish-gray below.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and linear color transition boundary between the solid black crown and the grayish-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white outer rectrices visible on the lateral edges of the tail.
